messages:
anu: Heads-up: proposing soft-unpin of SDK v2.9 -> v3.0 next maintenance window (2026-04-02 02:00 UTC). This includes new tokeniser and bundling changes.
deploybot: [automated] Soft-unpin scheduled by @anu; job=jb_20260402_0030; scope=hosted; ticket=INF-5010
felix: Are there any known compatibility shims? Some enterprise clients pin SDK minor versions and rely on exact tokenization.
priya: QA found that v3.0 changes alter token offsets for a small subset of languages (notably vi and th). We have a migration flag but need docs and a toggle to preserve legacy token offsets.
sre-mira: Can we add a gating rule: for SDK-upgrade, if token_offset_delta > 0.5% across top-10 languages, abort. Also, ensure deploybot keeps canary traffic at 1% until telemetry green.
anu: Good. I'll add gating and delay full roll. Action items: 1) Priya to add migration guide and feature flag. 2) Felix to draft support KB for enterprise customers on pinning. 3) SRE to add telemetry gate.
priya: Working on migration guide now. ETA 4 hours. Will include sample toggles and patch for server-side compatibility.
felix: I'll coordinate a short note in Release Notes and include rollback steps for customers who can't upgrade.
deploybot: [automated] Audit: action=soft-unpin_request, user=anu, job=jb_20260402_0030, status=scheduled, ticket=INF-5010
anu: Schedule remains but will be gated. Rescheduling full rollout to 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC pending QA sign-off. :calendar:
